item.title: Version 1.9.14
item.description:
See the day's move on every position

  • A Change column in the Portfolio window. The holdings list showed Last, Value, P&L and Weight, but not the one figure that changes minute to minute — how much each position has moved today. There's now a Change column between Last and Value, with the day's move in your currency and the percent below it, coloured green or red like the rest of the app.

The figures drop any trailing zeros, so a move reads as +12 rather than +12.00.
